name: r
description: Run R code in the user's live R session. Objects persist between calls and belong to the user. Returns printed output, messages, warnings, errors with a traceback, and plots as images. Execution stops at the first error. Output beyond about 4000 tokens keeps the first 40% and last 60% and names a gptr$out(id) handle for the rest.

code.description: R code to evaluate. May contain several expressions.

record.description: Record this code in the user's document (default true). Use false for throwaway inspection.

note.description: One-line decision or rationale, recorded as a '## Decision:' comment.

timeout.description: Seconds; best effort. Default: none when the user is present, else 3600.
